cues: Most hormones are held steady by negative feedback.
The hypothalamus releases T R H, the pituitary releases T S H, the thyroid makes thyroxine, which raises the metabolic rate.
And when thyroxine is high, it switches off the hypothalamus and pituitary.
text: Most hormones are held steady by negative feedback. The hypothalamus releases T R H, the pituitary releases T S H, the thyroid makes thyroxine, which raises the metabolic rate. And when thyroxine is high, it switches off the hypothalamus and pituitary. Like a thermostat.
